subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Revises consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th) at the end of a word (fi-sh, mu-ch, wi-th)

show.line: Two-letter sounds at the end too! Fi, sh. Fish! Mu, ch. Much! Wi, th. With!

rounds.prompt: Which one ends with sh, as in fish?
Listen. b, a, th. What word is it?
Much. What sound is at the end? Say it.
Which one ends with ch, as in much?

rounds.text: The fish is in the dish.
accept: the fish is in the dish
the fish is in the dish.

rounds.prompt: Does it end with sh, ch or th? Sort the pictures.

hints: Say the word slowly. Listen to the very end.
Fish ends in sh, like a quiet sound at the end.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the last sound in bath.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bath ends with th. Ba, th.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it slowly. Baaath. The last sound is th!

parent_line: Can hear and read sh, ch and th at the end of words.
